wish: someone should make a tool that simulates a simple climate model
spec:
Runs a zero-dimensional energy-balance climate model (one 100 m ocean layer, about 2.9 °C per CO2 doubling) for 200 years from the 1850 balance.
Set CO2, albedo and solar input with sliders, numbers or presets; it plots surface temperature year by year, shows where it settles and when it is half-way there, and lets you pin a run to compare.
It does not model regions, seasons, the deep ocean, ice sheets, carbon cycle or emission pathways; inputs are a single step change.
notes: Budyko linear outgoing radiation A + B*T with B = 1.3 W/m2/K, CO2 forcing 5.35 ln(C/280), calibrated so the 1850 inputs balance at 14.0 °C.
